subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with `includeDetails` be hidden before mutating-tool warning handling, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec details remain user-visible?
rationale: Current tests encode visible detail behavior, while this PR and its linked issue request a broader suppress-all policy; automation should not choose that product contract.

options.title: Clarify And Rewrite Before Merge
options.body: Choose the exec-like includeDetails contract, then update the branch, tests, and proof to match it before merge.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Warnings
options.body: Close or narrow this PR if cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec failures should remain visible.
